settings.title: Who is this for?
settings.content:
Perfect for anyone who wants:
  • A hydration surge without heaviness
  • A firmer, more contoured look over time
  • A boost in brightness and more even tone
  • A microcurrent-friendly mask for at-home or professional sessions
  • A travel-ready, single-use glow treatment
Whether you’re new to skincare or a pro building treatment menus ,this mask fits seamlessly into every routine.

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Cleanse.
  2. Unfold mask and apply, gently smoothing to facial contours.
  3. Leave on for 15–20 minutes.
  4. Remove mask and pat remaining essence into skin, follow with moisturizer if needed.

Pro tip: For enhanced results, use before a microcurrent session to improve conductivity and absorption.

settings.content:
• Deep Hydration & Plumpness - Sodium Hyaluronate + hydrating humectants help skin hold moisture and stay soft.

  • Easy, Spa-Level Mask at Home - Simple 15–20 minute application for instant replenishment and glow.

settings.heading: Here How Cell Renewal Peptide Mask Works
settings.section_content: A bio-cellulose sheet mask infused with EGF, Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, and botanical actives to deeply hydrate, support visible renewal, brighten tone, and smooth fine lines leaving skin plump, radiant, and refreshed.

settings.heading: What makes it different
settings.image_content: It’s built for people who are serious about long-term skin health, not just a glow-up. It supports your microcurrent routine, fights back against environmental stress, and helps your skin regenerate — day after day.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: Is this mask safe for all skin types?
settings.text1: Yes. The Cell Renewal Peptide Mask is formulated with soothing hydrators (Panthenol, Allantoin) and barrier-support ingredients, making it suitable for all skin types  including sensitive or dehydrated skin.
settings.title2: Can I use this mask with my MyoLift microcurrent device?
settings.text2: Yes. The mask is microcurrent-compatible and can be used before or after your MyoLift treatment for enhanced conductivity and absorption. It can also be used alone as a standalone skincare treatment.
settings.title3: How often can I use the mask?
settings.text3: You can use it 1–2 times per week, or anytime your skin needs extra hydration, renewal, or brightening support. Professionals may also use it before or after client microcurrent sessions.
settings.title4: What makes this mask different from regular sheet masks?
settings.text4: This is a bio-cellulose mask infused with EGF, Niacinamide, Sodium Hyaluronate, and botanical extracts. The material adheres tightly to the skin for better ingredient delivery, while the formula supports hydration, firmness, and visible tone improvement.
settings.text5: Yes. Each mask is single-use for hygiene and efficacy. After use, discard the sheet but pat the remaining essence into your skin for added nourishment.
settings.title6: Can I use it before makeup or an event?
settings.text6: Absolutely. The mask deeply hydrates and smooths the skin, creating a flawless base for makeup application. Many professionals use it as a pre-event skin prep step for a brighter, refreshed look.
